StartedWindow.MainTitle: Let’s pair your accessories using Smart Share
StartedWindow.Content: Easily connect your Bluetooth accessories (mouse, headphones, etc.) by tapping them to your PC.
StartedWindow.ContentGetStarted: Easily connect your Bluetooth accessories (mouse, headphones, etc.) by tapping them to your PC. Enable Bluetooth to get started.

TapToPairWindow.SubContent1: Put your accessory in Bluetooth pairing mode.
TapToPairWindow.SubContent2: Gently touch your accessory twice to either side of your PC to pair.

EnjoyWindow.Title: Pairing complete!
EnjoyWindow.UnpairedTitle: Pair devices with a double tap
EnjoyWindow.Content: To add more devices in the future, ensure that your PC has Bluetooth turned on and that your accessories are in pairing mode. Then, simply double tap them to your PC!
